title: The Little Red Hen
author: Traditional, retelling
credit: An original retelling of a traditional tale (public-domain source).

pages: The little red hen found a seed.
"Who will help me plant it?" she said.
"Not I," said the cat. "Not I," said the dog.
So she planted it all by herself.
The seed grew into tall wheat.
"Who will help me cut it?" "Not I!"
She made the wheat into bread.
"Who will help me eat it?" "I will!" said the cat and the dog.
"No," said the hen. "I will eat it." And she did!

quiz.q: What did the little red hen find?
quiz.ev: The little red hen found a seed.

quiz.q: Why did the hen eat the bread by herself?
quiz.ev: So she planted it all by herself.
